description: Na₂U(TeO₅)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four TeO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-62°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.79 Å. U is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.32 Å. There are two inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded to six O atoms to form TeO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent TeO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one TeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-41°. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.03 Å. In the second Te site, Te is bonded to six O atoms to form TeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TeO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one TeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-62°. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.04 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Te atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Te atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Te atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent U and one Te atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Te atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Te atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent U and one Te atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Te atoms.
